findings.title: No current qualification cell is proven
findings.expected: Twelve complete exact-candidate journeys with all eight stages and required negative/human scenarios.
findings.observed: The retained #915 manifest has empty stage arrays, its gate is incomplete with zero verified scenarios, #916 records 0/12 accepted, and #1150 has not executed qualification.
findings.uncertainty: Historical activity exists, but it cannot be assigned current cell credit without exact candidate and tuple bindings.
findings.recommended_follow_up: After prerequisites and authorization, execute each tuple through its declared execution profile and retain actual stage records.

findings.title: No current Q01-Q24 obligation is proven
findings.expected: Twenty-four source-mapped obligations linked to exact-candidate executed scenarios and independent review.
findings.observed: The retained #915 handoff supplies every requirement text, but all rows are unproven_for_selected_candidate with empty scenario_ids and no #1150 execution exists.
findings.uncertainty: The semantic map is available; current candidate execution and review evidence are absent.
findings.recommended_follow_up: After prerequisites and authority are admitted, execute and independently review scenarios mapped to every Q row.

findings.title: Required producer acceptance and exact installed lockset are not evidenced
findings.expected: Accepted CodeFriend #34/#44/#45 and ADL #1148/#1149 results plus exact installed product, website, templates, source scopes, platforms, provider/profile, and hashes.
findings.observed: The current #1150 scheduler reports dependencies_ready, design_ready, and budget_available blocked; issue closure and retained component proofs do not supply accepted producer receipts or a current lockset.
findings.uncertainty: Producer work may exist elsewhere, but no accepted current receipt is present in the inspected repository evidence.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Attach authenticated producer acceptance and freeze one exact current candidate before any run.

findings.title: Six exports are valid historical artifacts but cannot satisfy cell or obligation coverage
findings.expected: Approved exports bound to a complete exact-candidate cell, source, platform, review record, semantic parity, and human HTML/PDF inspection.
findings.observed: Six ADL/Vector Markdown/HTML/PDF artifacts exited zero and carry incomplete warnings, but have no surface/platform binding and #916 preserves 0/12 accepted.
findings.uncertainty: Owner-reported inspection exists historically, but the retained matrix does not bind it to accepted tuple records.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Reuse hashes as adverse historical inputs only; regenerate and inspect exports within each current-candidate journey where the original contract requires them.

findings.title: Current-tree product proofs have narrower claim boundaries
findings.expected: Product proof reusable at the exact #1150 candidate across both repositories, both platforms, all surfaces, provider-backed review, comparison, exports, and human inspection.
findings.observed: Retained proof packets are Darwin-arm64 component/fixture proofs with explicit no-provider, no-external-source, no-Linux, no-publication, or no-CI claims.
findings.uncertainty: They may reduce setup risk, but no current candidate linkage or denominator coverage is established.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Use them as preparation references and negative-contract guidance without qualification credit.
